tiny_nerf_depth_uncertainty.description: Scaled benchmark target generated by this reproduction, not paper-reported: uncertainty should rank held-out depth errors better than random uncertainty.

ause.description: Area under the sparsification error curve for held-out depth uncertainty.

spearman_depth_error.description: Rank correlation between predicted uncertainty and held-out depth error.

mean_depth_error.description: Mean held-out depth error, included to detect uncertainty gains that degrade rendering geometry.

source_view_count.description: Number of source views used before uncertainty scoring.

used_ground_truth_for_uncertainty.description: Indicator that ground-truth labels were used to construct uncertainty scores.

tiny_nerf_active_view_proxy.description: Scaled benchmark target generated by this reproduction, not paper-reported: selected candidate view should expose more current model error than random candidate selection under the same budget.

selected_candidate_error.description: Current rendering error exposed by the selected next-view candidate.

selected_error_lift.description: Selected candidate exposed error divided by the candidate-pool mean exposed error.

selection_regret.description: Gap between the best candidate's exposed error and the selected candidate's exposed error.

selection_regret_fraction.description: Selection regret divided by the candidate-pool mean exposed error.

candidate_score_spearman.description: Rank correlation between candidate scores and evaluator-computed candidate rendering errors.

top_half_error_lift.description: Mean exposed error in the top half of scored candidates divided by the full candidate mean.

view_budget.description: Number of source views after adding the selected candidate.
